source: Vev Blog - 6 Dark Mode Website Color Palette Ideas
project_context: Charly's Corner Store - Neon-Retro 80s Themed E-commerce Website

dark_mode_color_palettes.name: Monochromatic Minimalism
dark_mode_color_palettes.description: Clean, elegant, professional look using varying shades of gray and black. Provides depth and contrast while maintaining minimalist aesthetic.
dark_mode_color_palettes.why_it_works: Minimal use of color directs focus to content and improves readability without distracting the user.
dark_mode_color_palettes.retro_80s_applicability: LOW - Too muted for neon-retro aesthetic, but good for admin/dashboard areas

dark_mode_color_palettes.name: Neon Highlights
dark_mode_color_palettes.description: Dynamic, futuristic feel combining dark backgrounds with bright, neon accents. Colors stand out vividly against dark backdrop.
dark_mode_color_palettes.why_it_works: High contrast between neon and dark mode creates high-energy vibe while maintaining readability and visual clarity.
dark_mode_color_palettes.retro_80s_applicability: HIGH - Perfect match for Miami Vice/synthwave aesthetic

dark_mode_color_palettes.name: Warm Tones
dark_mode_color_palettes.description: Cozy, welcoming dark mode using deep oranges, reds, and browns. Evokes comfort and nostalgia.
dark_mode_color_palettes.why_it_works: Warm tones create welcoming contrast with dark backgrounds, making site feel inviting and intimate.
dark_mode_color_palettes.retro_80s_applicability: MEDIUM - Sunset/sunrise gradients complement neon aesthetic

dark_mode_color_palettes.name: Muted Pastels
dark_mode_color_palettes.description: Soft and calming palette with gentle blues, pinks, and lavenders. Serene and approachable.
dark_mode_color_palettes.why_it_works: Soft pastels contrast beautifully against dark backgrounds without overwhelming the eye.
dark_mode_color_palettes.retro_80s_applicability: MEDIUM - Soft pinks and lavenders work with 80s vaporwave aesthetic

dark_mode_color_palettes.name: Deep Jewel Tones
dark_mode_color_palettes.description: Rich, luxurious palette with emerald green, sapphire blue, and ruby red. Sleek, modern appearance.
dark_mode_color_palettes.why_it_works: Jewel tones add sophistication and depth, making website feel premium and high-end.
dark_mode_color_palettes.retro_80s_applicability: LOW-MEDIUM - Rich but not vibrant enough for pure 80s neon

dark_mode_color_palettes.name: Contrasting Vibrancy
dark_mode_color_palettes.description: Bold, playful approach pairing dark backgrounds with highly saturated accent colors. Brings energy to design.
dark_mode_color_palettes.why_it_works: Bright colors inject energy into dark design while preserving sleek modernity.
dark_mode_color_palettes.retro_80s_applicability: HIGH - Saturated colors align with bold 80s aesthetic

recommended_palette_for_charlys_corner_s.name: Miami Vice Neon-Retro Fusion
recommended_palette_for_charlys_corner_s.description: Custom palette combining best elements from Neon Highlights and Contrasting Vibrancy palettes, optimized for 80s screen-printing ecommerce

usage_guidelines.borders_glows: 1-2px solid with 0 0 10px/20px box-shadow using neon colors

dark_mode_best_practices: Use pure black (#0D0D0D or #121212) for backgrounds, not dark gray
Maintain sufficient contrast ratios (WCAG AA compliance: 4.5:1 for text)
Use accent colors sparingly - 60/30/10 rule (60% neutral, 30% secondary, 10% accent)
Avoid pure white (#FFFFFF) for large text blocks - use off-white (#E0E0E0, #F0F0F0)
Implement subtle depth with layered backgrounds (#121212 base, #1A1A1A cards, #2C2C2C elevated)
neon_specific_patterns: Use neon colors for: CTAs, active states, hover effects, highlights, badges
Add glow effects (box-shadow) to neon elements for authentic 80s feel
Combine 2-3 neon colors in gradients for hero sections
Use dark backgrounds to let neon colors 'pop' naturally
Maintain at least 70% dark space to avoid visual overload
Use neon sparingly - one primary neon + one secondary maximum per component

buttons.primary: Neon background (#FF0099 or #00FFFF) with dark text, glow on hover
buttons.secondary: Dark background with neon border, fill on hover
buttons.ghost: Transparent with neon text, underline or glow on hover

css_variables_setup.description: Define all colors as CSS variables for single-source-of-truth maintenance

accessibility_dark_mode.contrast_check: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text, 3:1 for large text
accessibility_dark_mode.focus_indicators: Use neon colors for focus rings: outline: 2px solid var(--neon-cyan);

design_system_approach: Define colors as Variables (CSS custom properties) - single source of truth
Build component variants for light/dark modes using same structure, different visuals
Save approved components to a Library for team consistency
Document usage guidelines for each color (primary CTA, secondary, hover, etc.)
Create a color usage matrix showing which colors work together
implementation_workflow: 1. Define palette hex codes in CSS variables
2. Map variables to semantic names (--color-cta, --color-link, etc.)
3. Build base components (buttons, cards, inputs) with dark mode colors
4. Create neon glow utility classes for effects
5. Test contrast ratios for accessibility compliance
6. Document the system for team reference
maintenance_tips: Use linting to catch hardcoded colors outside variables
Create visual regression tests for color consistency
Establish naming conventions and stick to them
Version control your design system changes
Regular audits for color drift across pages
performance: Prefer CSS variables over inline styles for colors
Use will-change sparingly on animated neon elements
Consider using CSS containment for neon-heavy sections
Optimize glow effects - avoid excessive blur radius
Use GPU-accelerated properties (transform, opacity) for animations

inspiration_sources: Retro arcade (neon green + black + pixel fonts)

typography_pairings.display: Retro script or bold geometric fonts (Neon Glow effect)
typography_pairings.body: Clean sans-serif with high contrast (Aeonik, Inter, Geist)

texture_effects: Grid background patterns (CSS grid or SVG)
Noise texture for retro film grain feel
animation_patterns: Glitch effect on hover for interactive elements
